integrity: The cardinal functions and monotone-data simplex reduction are derived exactly. The unique edge maximizer is proved by polynomial sign analysis; a separate bound excludes a larger central-cell defect. The packaged standard-library checker replays the rational identities and algebraic root brackets. The source date is the dated public repository record of 2011-12-18; journal issue dates are not used as source-date evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies bounded monotone range behavior only for four equally spaced nodes and Floater–Hormann blending degree d=1. It does not classify longer stencils, other blending degrees, or derivative monotonicity.
title: Sharp monotone range defect of four-point degree-one Floater–Hormann interpolation
